classification.difficultyReason: Student must split the quadrilateral along AC unaided: a right-angled triangle plus an SAS triangle, with no triangles named.

content.prompt: A drawing of a market garden is shown. Calculate the area of the garden in square m correct to one decimal place. The labelled angle at $D$ is rounded.

answer.worked:
Join $A$ to $C$ to split the garden into $\Delta ABC$ and $\Delta ACD$.
$$\begin{align*}
A_{ABC}&=\frac12(8)(6)\sin90^\circ=24\\[8pt]
A_{ACD}&=\frac12(7)(9)\sin76.2^\circ\\[8pt]
A&=24+31.5\sin76.2^\circ\\[8pt]
A&\approx54.6\text{ m}^2
\end{align*}$$
